references.text: Also emphasizes the necessity of being prepared because one does not know when the time will come.
Stresses the importance of being prepared because the Son of Man will come at an unexpected time.
Encourages staying awake and being ready because Jesus will return at a time when no one expects it.
Points out that the day of the Lord comes like a thief, and emphasizes the need to be prepared.
Jesus states that he will come like a thief and stresses the importance of staying awake and being prepared.
